document:6:596:0.text:
First, peel the <style="highlight">fresh oranges</style> and place them into a crucible. Then, crush them thoroughly until every last drop of juice has been extracted.
Next, pour <style="highlight">cool spring water</style> into the juice and add an appropriate amount of <style="highlight">powdered rock sugar</style> to balance its acidity.
Finally, use magic to stir the mixture vigorously until it turns a vibrant golden orange and gives off a refreshing aroma.
document:6:596:0.source_cn:
首先，将去皮的<style="highlight">新鲜甜橘</style>投入坩埚，用力挤压直至果肉完全破碎，确保每一滴果汁都被榨取出来。
其次，向果汁中注入<style="highlight">清凉的泉水</style>，并根据口味加入适量的<style="highlight">冰糖粉末</style>，以中和汁液的酸度与甜度。
最后，用魔法进行急速搅拌，让糖分与果汁瞬间完美融合，直到液体呈现出诱人的金橙色，并散发出清新的香气。
